title: SHA-256 hash is computed deterministically for identical file content
preconditions: Hashing utility function is imported in isolation, no DB/S3 dependency
steps: Call the hash utility twice with the same buffer
Compare the two resulting hash strings
expectedResult: Both calls return the identical SHA-256 hex digest.

title: Control coverage percentage excludes deprecated evidence from the denominator
preconditions: Coverage calculation function under test with a fixture set containing active and deprecated evidence
steps: Build a fixture with 10 controls, 6 with active evidence, 2 with only deprecated evidence, 2 with none
expectedResult: Coverage is reported as 6/10 (60%), not counting the 2 controls whose only evidence is deprecated.

title: Retention expiry date is calculated from upload date plus policy duration
steps: Call the retention calculator with uploadDate=2026-01-01 and policy=365 days

title: hasTriggerFieldChange() bumps a version only for title/description/category/subCategory/files updates
description: EvidenceVersionService.VERSION_TRIGGER_FIELDS gates whether an update goes through the versioned-transaction path or a cheap direct $set. Ground truth: evidence-version.service.js hasTriggerFieldChange().
preconditions: hasTriggerFieldChange tested in isolation with plain updateData objects
expectedResult: First and third calls return false (no version bump — status/tags/metadata are non-trigger fields); second call returns true (title is a trigger field).

title: buildOrgScope() ignores a spoofed ?orgId query param for non-super-admin callers
description: buildOrgScope(req) is duplicated across evidence.controller.js, evidence-upload.controller.js, and evidence-mapping.controller.js. It must only honor req.query.orgId when the caller holds the 'organization.admin' permission; otherwise it must always return req.orgId.
preconditions: buildOrgScope() tested with mock req objects, no DB/HTTP dependency
steps: Call buildOrgScope with req.permissions NOT containing 'organization.admin', req.orgId='orgA', req.query.orgId='orgB'
Call buildOrgScope with req.permissions containing 'organization.admin', same req.orgId/req.query.orgId
expectedResult: First call returns 'orgA' (spoofed query param ignored). Second call returns 'orgB' (super-admin override honored).
